---
title: "ffaframework: Environment Check"
output: html_notebook
---

This R Notebook checks that the project's `renv` environment is active and that `ffaframework` loads and runs successfully.

## 1. Load ffaframework

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
renv::restore(prompt = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ffaframework)
```

## 2. Plot Data from "Kootenai River at Porthill (08NH021)"

```{r}
df <- data_local("CAN-08NH021.csv")
head(df)
plot_ams_data(df$max, df$year, title = "Kootenai River at Porthill (08NH021)")
```
